native_contract.light_encumbrance: when encumbrance percent < 33 and the character is living, add 10-trunc(encumbrancePercent/10)
native_contract.dead_branch: non-living fighter construction stores raw Dodge -1
native_contract.consumer: _calculate_attack reads fighter +0x20, computes trunc(rawDodge*10 / trunc(accuracy/8)), caps at 95%, and divides by 5 for Backstab.

supersedes: CodeUpdate0334 did not identify the matching base-stat/encumbrance raw-Dodge callsite; 0356 directly identifies it inside exported _move_player_to_fighter.
runtime: RuntimeClassicCharacterFormulaCalculator.CalculateRawDodge already matches native signed/truncating arithmetic and the <33 encumbrance boundary. 0356 upgrades its evidence authority rather than inventing a replacement formula.
megamud_compatibility: MegaMUD contains Dodge recognition strings and consumes ordinary server combat outcomes; no client-side raw-Dodge calculation is required.
borin_compatibility: Borin consumes authoritative server combat outcomes/state and must not substitute a private raw-Dodge formula.
